name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: US–Iran war continues under a naval blockade; Iran says 'ball in US court' as Israel presses for new strikes
state: The war that began with US–Israeli strikes on Iran on 28 Feb continues under a US naval blockade, with a ship hit by a projectile in Hormuz on 2 Nov. Iran said on 2 Nov it had passed a proposal via Qatar and the 'ball is in the US court'; Trump said the war would end 'one way or the other' (Al Jazeera). Officials told AP Netanyahu wants new strikes after the 3 Nov midterms.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to much of the region; follow its travel advice and airline updates.
